title: Southwest Tofu Scramble
description: Crumbled extra-firm tofu sizzled with red onion, bell pepper and kale, then coated in a cumin, chili and garlic spice paste. Pile it with salsa and cilantro for a hearty, protein-rich plate.
watch: Serve with GF toast only (skip regular toast). Contains soy (tofu).

title: Strawberries & Cream Chia Pudding
description: Fresh strawberries blended into creamy coconut milk and set with chia seeds into a pink, spoonable pudding. Stir it together the night before and grab a jar in the morning.
swaps: If not using coconut milk, use oat or soy milk (not almond/cashew). Skip graham cracker topping unless certified GF and vegan.
watch: Contains coconut (coconut milk; optional coconut whip). Use dairy-free, nut-free yogurt if topping.

title: Decadent Chocolate Overnight Oats
description: Rolled oats soaked overnight with cocoa, chia and a little maple until thick and brownie-like. Top with raspberries for a breakfast that tastes like dessert.
swaps: Use oat or soy milk instead of almond milk; use sunflower seed butter instead of almond butter (the recipe allows seed butters).
watch: Use certified GF oats. Skip nut-butter and coconut toppings or note coconut.

title: Easy Fluffy Gluten-Free Vegan Buttermilk Pancakes
description: A six-ingredient, top-8-free stack where non-dairy milk curdled with vinegar gives a tangy buttermilk-style lift. Fast enough for a weekday and freezer-friendly for later.
swaps: Use oat, soy or rice milk for the non-dairy milk (not almond/cashew).
watch: Recipe uses Bob's Red Mill 1-to-1 GF Baking Flour; confirm the blend you buy has no almond or other nut flour.

title: Cocoa Banana Cinnamon Quinoa Flakes
description: A hot porridge made from quinoa flakes, mashed ripe banana and cocoa, warmed with cinnamon. It's a chocolatey, oat-free alternative to oatmeal that's ready in minutes.
watch: Buy quinoa flakes labeled gluten-free.

title: The Best Gluten-Free Vegan Waffle
description: Crisp-edged waffles built on a rice-and-sorghum flour blend plus oat flour, bound with a flax egg and olive oil. A reliable base for berries and maple syrup.
swaps: Use oat, soy, rice or hemp milk for the nondairy milk (not almond/cashew).
watch: Use certified GF oat flour. Make the author's linked flour blend (rice/sorghum/starches) or use a nut-free GF blend. Contains flax.

title: Gluten-Free Vegan Banana French Toast
description: Thick slices of sturdy GF bread dunked in a blended banana, flax, cinnamon and rice-milk custard, then griddled until golden. Banana stands in for egg and adds natural sweetness.
watch: Use a certified GF, egg-free, dairy-free bread (author suggests Ener-G, Canyon Bakehouse, Schar etc. — check each for egg/milk). Use nut-free vegan butter (e.g., Earth Balance, not cashew-based). Coconut whipped cream topping contains coconut.

title: Gluten-Free Vegan Baked Pumpkin Oatmeal
description: Rolled oats baked with pumpkin purée, maple syrup and pumpkin pie spice into a soft, sliceable casserole. Perfect for feeding a crowd or reheating all week.
watch: Use certified GF oats. Use nut-free vegan butter (Earth Balance per author, not cashew-based).

title: Blender SunButter, Banana & Buckwheat Waffles
description: Whole buckwheat groats are blended straight into a batter with banana, sunflower seed butter and rice milk for nutty-tasting, protein-boosted waffles with no flour to measure.
watch: Uses SunButter (sunflower seed butter) — confirm a brand made in a nut-free facility. Buckwheat is gluten-free despite the name.

title: Flaxseed Pancakes (Vegan + Gluten-Free)
description: Whole flaxseeds blended into the batter make these pancakes fluffy and slightly nutty, with a fiber boost and no egg needed. A wholesome everyday stack.
swaps: Use oat or soy milk instead of almond milk.
watch: Use a GF flour blend without almond flour. Contains flax.

title: Vegan Country Breakfast Skillet
description: A diner-style one-pan feast: crispy herbed potatoes, fennel-spiced 'sausage' crumbles and a turmeric tofu scramble layered together. Great for a slow weekend brunch.
swaps: Make the crumbles with TVP or soy curls (not wheat-based vegan sausage). Use soy or coconut yogurt instead of nut-based yogurt. Use a nut-free vegan cheese or skip it.
watch: Many vegan sausages and cheeses contain wheat gluten or cashews — read labels. Check ketchup for allergens. Contains soy.

title: AIP and Whole30 Breakfast Hash
description: Diced Japanese sweet potatoes and thinly shaved Brussels sprouts crisped in a skillet with onion and a savory breakfast spice blend. Naturally egg-free and grain-free.
swaps: Use olive or avocado oil instead of ghee (the recipe allows any cooking fat).
watch: If adding sausage or bacon on the side, check labels for fillers.

title: Gluten Free Chocolate Chip Pancakes (Teff Flour)
description: Earthy teff flour and applesauce make tender, egg-free pancakes studded with melty allergy-friendly chocolate chips. A weekend treat kids love.
swaps: Use oat, soy or rice milk (or water) — not almond or dairy milk.
watch: Use Enjoy Life chips (check label) and a nut-free GF white flour mix.

title: Pumpkin Seed Gluten-Free Granola
description: A grain-free, nut-free granola of pumpkin, sunflower, sesame and flax seeds toasted with maple syrup and pumpkin spice. Crunchy over dairy-free yogurt or by the handful.
watch: Contains coconut (unsweetened flakes; can be omitted). Buy seeds from nut-free facilities if sensitive.

title: The Best Toasted Maple Sesame Granola
description: Gluten-free oats, sunflower seeds and toasty sesame baked with maple and cinnamon into golden clusters. A simple, nut-free pantry staple.
watch: Use certified GF oats. Use avocado oil to avoid coconut (coconut oil is the other option).

title: 2-Ingredient Vegan Buckwheat Crepes
description: Just buckwheat flour and water make thin, lacy crepes that go sweet with fruit or savory with sautéed veggies. Surprisingly simple for something this elegant.
swaps: Use water as written (skip the optional nut milk). Grease with oil or nut-free vegan butter.
watch: Buy buckwheat flour labeled gluten-free (cross-contact with wheat is common).

title: Vegan Crepes (Chickpea Crepes)
description: Chickpea flour gives these thin crepes an eggy richness and sturdy fold, ideal for savory fillings or a sweet vanilla version.
swaps: Use a grain-based GF flour blend instead of all-purpose flour; use soy or oat milk (not almond/cashew).
watch: GF blend must be nut-free. Use nut-free vegan butter.

title: Vegan Breakfast Hash
description: Cubed potatoes, peppers and onion pan-fried with Italian seasoning and browned vegan breakfast sausage. A filling, one-skillet savory breakfast.
swaps: Use a certified GF vegan breakfast sausage with no wheat gluten or nuts (author suggests Beyond), or swap in crumbled tofu.
watch: Most vegan sausages contain wheat gluten — read labels carefully. Skip vegan cheddar unless nut-free.

title: Maple Sage Breakfast Patties
description: Homemade pork sausage patties seasoned with fresh sage, a touch of maple and garlic — no fillers, binders or mystery ingredients. Freeze a batch for quick mornings.
watch: Use plain ground pork with no added seasonings.

title: Quinoa Breakfast Porridge
description: Quinoa simmered in plant milk with maple, vanilla and cardamom until creamy, then topped with berries. A protein-rich, oat-free warm bowl.
swaps: Use oat or soy milk. Skip nut and peanut-butter topping ideas.
watch: Toasted coconut garnish contains coconut (optional).

title: Pitaya Dragon Fruit Smoothie Bowl
description: Frozen pink dragon fruit and banana whipped into a thick magenta bowl, ready for fruit and seed toppings. Bright, refreshing and two ingredients at its core.
swaps: Top with fruit and seeds only — skip nuts and use only nut-free, GF granola.
watch: Shredded coconut topping contains coconut (optional).

title: Breakfast Potatoes (Crispy + Tender)
description: Oven-roasted potato cubes tossed with garlic powder and paprika until crisp outside and fluffy inside. An easy side for tofu scrambles or sausage.
swaps: Skip the suggested sriracha cashew cream topping.
watch: If adding seasoning blends (Old Bay, Italian), check labels.

title: Vegan Baked Oatmeal
description: Banana-sweetened oats baked with chewy dates, raisins and toasted sesame into soft, sliceable squares. Spiced with cinnamon and nutmeg for a cozy grab-and-go breakfast.
swaps: Use oat or soy milk instead of almond milk; replace pecans with pumpkin or sunflower seeds (or omit).
watch: Use certified GF oats.

title: Vegan Blueberry Muffins (Gluten-Free, Nut-Free)
description: Tender oat-flour muffins bursting with blueberries, sweetened with coconut sugar and maple and lifted with aquafaba instead of eggs.
watch: Use certified GF oat flour and oat milk. Use nut-free vegan butter. Contains coconut sugar (coconut-derived).

title: Chickpea Flour Omelette (Vegan)
description: A thin chickpea-flour batter seasoned with black salt cooks up like an eggy omelette, ready to fold around spinach, peppers and mushrooms.
swaps: Cook in olive oil (not vegan butter unless nut-free); skip vegan cheese unless nut-free.
watch: Buy chickpea flour labeled gluten-free.

title: Sausage-Flavored Breakfast Beans and Grits
description: White beans simmered with sage, fennel and smoked paprika for all the flavor of breakfast sausage, spooned over creamy corn grits with wilted spinach. Southern comfort, no meat needed.
watch: Use corn grits labeled gluten-free. Check vegetable broth labels.

title: Easy Green Veggie-Packed Smoothie Bowl
description: Avocado, banana, strawberries, spinach and kale blended with hemp milk into a thick green bowl, then topped with berries and seeds.
watch: Coconut water is an optional sub for hemp milk (contains coconut). Choose seed toppings from nut-free facilities.

title: Moist and Flavorful Breakfast Muffins (Top 8 Free)
description: A flexible, top-8-free muffin base made with applesauce or banana that you can turn into chocolate chip, apple cinnamon, double chocolate or multi-seed versions.
watch: Use purity-protocol/certified GF oat flour and a nut-free GF flour blend. Use avocado oil to avoid coconut oil.
